name: Mid-Atlantic Regional Spaceport LP-0A

sources.title: Wikipedia: Mid-Atlantic Regional Spaceport
sources.note: spaceport coordinates 37.84333 N, 75.47806 W; LP-0A associated rockets: Antares 100- and 200-series (retired); status 'undergoing renovation'

notes: Coordinates are the SPACEPORT's, not the pad's own: the page lists several pad coordinates without labelling which is LP-0A (they differ by about 1 km). No azimuth or inclination range is given. There are no v1 launch windows for this site yet.
